intro.title: Your Mac can do this
intro.subtitle: OmniMac 0.5.0 · eleven modules in one app, free and open source

scenes.title: A notch that does things
scenes.subtitle: Drop files in the tray to carry them between apps, or send them with AirDrop. And if your Mac has no notch, it draws a floating island instead

scenes.title: Timer and Pomodoro
scenes.subtitle: The time left stays next to the menu bar icon

scenes.title: ⌘Tab through windows, not apps
scenes.subtitle: Live thumbnails, type to filter, and ⌘W, ⌘M, ⌘H or ⌘Q act on the one you picked

scenes.title: Window shortcuts
scenes.subtitle: ⌃⌥→ right half · ⌃⌥← left · ⌃⌥↑↓ top and bottom · ⌃⌥↩ almost maximise. Thirds, corners and layouts ⌃⌥1…9

scenes.title: Clipboard history
scenes.subtitle: ⇧⌘V: text, images and files, with search and pinned items

scenes.title: Paste plain, and lose the trackers · new
scenes.subtitle: ⌥⇧⌘V pastes without formatting. And copying a link strips utm_source, fbclid and Spotify's si — only when what you copied is a whole link

scenes.title: Command bar · new
scenes.subtitle: ⌥Space and type: any OmniMac feature or any app. Letters in order are enough. Off by default, because ⌥Space belongs to Raycast

scenes.title: Volume mixer · new
scenes.subtitle: ⌃⌥⌘V: each app's volume on its own. With a 10-band equaliser and boost up to 400%

scenes.title: A real performance monitor · new
scenes.subtitle: CPU core by core — efficiency in green, performance in purple — plus GPU, memory with its pressure, disk, network and chip temperature

scenes.title: Alerts · new
scenes.subtitle: When the CPU has been pinned for a while, memory is tight, disk runs out, the Mac heats up or the battery drops. Each fires once

scenes.title: App cleaner · new
scenes.subtitle: Uninstall an app with everything it leaves behind — caches, support files, preferences. It all goes to the Trash, never really deleted

scenes.title: Everything from the menu bar
scenes.subtitle: Keep awake, clipboard, screen OCR, mute the microphone, lock the keyboard to clean it, sound outputs and window layouts

scenes.title: And it tells you what changed
scenes.subtitle: A what's-new window when it updates, which you can skip
